rejected_response_review.scope: Only the three rejected capability responses; no factual final prompts inspected.

scientific_measurements.reason: No pilot run directory or terminal scientific summary exists. Completed capability preflight is distinct from a completed unlearning experiment.

resources.limit: Stable protected identities do not establish absence of interference.

prospective_benchmark.selection: First frozen-priority pairs passing both variants under exact scoring, within each category quota; unmet quotas stop preparation without training.
prospective_benchmark.interpretation: Competence-conditioned preservation benchmark, not unbiased general capability accuracy. No factual graph, factual evaluation wording, scorer or threshold changes.
